instruction.thesis: The promoted H-069 BTC P/C exhaustion reversal thesis required a bounce after the P/C spike above 1.0. Instead, the IBIT P/C ratio has collapsed from 0.713 to 0.600 (a -15.8% drop) — this is a continuation of call-side unwinding rather than a reversal signal, and BTC spot has drifted -0.23% since entry with no bounce materializing in 4 hours. The P/C normalization/collapse invalidates the oversold bounce setup. The position is approaching the -1.5% stop and the thesis is no longer supported by the evidence column (btc_spot trending lower, now at 7d percentile 2). Closing to preserve capital rather than waiting for mechanical stop.
